section_summary.extract_value: This subsection (2.2.3 Body pride) describes the 6-item Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES), noting items are rated 1 (Never) to 5 (Always) and averaged to reflect authentic body pride. It states the measure has supportive psychometric evidence in Western samples. The text contains no study-specific details (no Study 1/Study 2 labels, sample sizes, demographics, methods, or statistical results).
section_summary.evidence_source: Full provided text of subsection 2.2.3: "The 6-item Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES14) measures body pride as a sense of personal appearance-related achievement (sample item: 'I am proud of my appearance efforts'). Responses to the six items are rated on a 5-point scale, ranging from 1 (Never) to 5 (Always), and averaged such that higher scores are reflective of greater authentic body pride. There is supportive evidence of the measure's factor structure, validity, test– retest reliability, and internal consistency in Western samples.14"
